# Claude Guard (claude-guard)

> 100% Local Claude Environment Ban-Risk Auditor, Claude Code Multi-Provider Switcher (AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI / OpenRouter), and Chrome/Edge Manifest V3 Auto-Backup Vault Extension.

- **Live Web App & Diagnostic Radar**: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/claude-guard/
- **Chrome/Edge MV3 Extension Download**: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/claude-guard/downloads/claude-guard-mv3.zip
- **Claude Code Multi-Provider Switcher Kit**: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/claude-guard/downloads/claude-code-kit.zip
- **Structured Pricing**: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/claude-guard/pricing.md
- **Parent Storefront**: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/opc-tools/

## Core Capabilities
1. **10-Second Claude Ban Risk Audit**: Detects Datacenter/Hosting ASN IPs (Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Vultr, etc.), WebRTC real IP leaks, `Asia/Shanghai` timezone vs IP geolocation mismatches, and Claude Code telemetry exposure (`DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1`).
2. **Claude Code Zero-Ban Configuration Generator**: Generates `~/.claude/settings.json` and CLI switcher scripts (`cc-switch.sh` / `cc-switch.ps1`) for seamless switching between Official Hardened mode, AWS Bedrock (`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1`), Google Cloud Vertex AI (`CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1`), and OpenRouter.
3. **Manifest V3 Local Conversation & Artifact Vault**: Passively backs up `claude.ai` conversations and code blocks into local browser storage (`chrome.storage.local`) and exports clean Markdown + a 1-click "New Account Context Recovery Handoff Prompt".
